# horsie_model (Resource)

A model alias sessions and agent presets select by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "horsie_model" "sonnet" {
  alias          = "sonnet"
  model_provider = horsie_model_provider.anthropic.name
  model_id       = "claude-sonnet-4-6"

  thinking_efforts = ["none", "low", "high"]
  thinking_effort  = "low"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `alias` (String) The name sessions select, e.g. `sonnet`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `model_id` (String) The provider's own model identifier, e.g. `claude-sonnet-4-6`.
- `model_provider` (String) Name of the `horsie_model_provider` this routes to. The server rejects a model naming a provider that does not exist, so reference the resource's `name` to let Terraform order the two correctly.

### Optional

- `context_window` (Number) Total context window in tokens. horsie fills in a built-in default for model ids it recognises, which is why this is computed when omitted.
- `forced_tools_disable_thinking` (Boolean) Set for backends that reject a pinned `tool_choice` while thinking is enabled. Defaults to false.
- `max_tokens` (Number) Cap on output tokens per request.
- `thinking_dialect` (String) Wire encoding for this model's thinking control.
- `thinking_effort` (String) Default effort when a session picks none. Must be one of `thinking_efforts`.
- `thinking_efforts` (List of String) Thinking-effort levels this model offers, in ascending order. Omit for a model with no thinking control.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Resources are addressed by their name/alias, which is the id of record.
terraform import horsie_model.example sonnet
```
